changes.zh: 硬件要求：MIMIC-IV 规模的数据库建议 16 GB 内存，4 核约 70 分钟；14 GB 也能完成，但会触发一次内存不足后的自动减半重试。eICU 需要高内存服务器：4 个 worker 不限内存时峰值约 88 GiB，限制在 32 GB 时可完成但有 3 次自动重试。各库 4 个 worker 不限内存时的峰值：MIMIC-IV 19.4、AUMC 17.4、HiRID 17.6、eICU 87.7、SICdb 7.4、MIMIC-III 14.5 GiB。14 GB 内的优化留到 0.1.1。
changes.en: Hardware: MIMIC-IV-scale databases need 16 GB RAM and take about 70 minutes on 4 cores; 14 GB also completes, after one automatic halve-on-out-of-memory retry. eICU needs a high-memory server: about 88 GiB peak with 4 workers and no memory cap; under a 32 GB cap it completes with 3 automatic retries. Peak memory per database with 4 workers and no cap: MIMIC-IV 19.4, AUMC 17.4, HiRID 17.6, eICU 87.7, SICdb 7.4, MIMIC-III 14.5 GiB. Fitting within 14 GB is planned for 0.1.1.

changes.zh: 概念缓存的标识包含计算代码本身；升级后旧版本写入的缓存不再被复用，会重新计算。
changes.en: The concept cache key now includes the computing code, so after an upgrade a cache written by an older version is recomputed instead of reused.

changes.zh: 数据转换中途取消后，重新扫描或重启应用仍显示为未完成，不会误判为可以分析；继续转换完成后才变为就绪。
changes.en: A data conversion cancelled midway stays incomplete after a rescan or restart instead of being reported ready for analysis; it becomes ready once a resumed conversion finishes.

changes.zh: 模型服务返回错误且响应缓慢时，应用的其他请求不再被卡住。
changes.en: A slow error response from the model service no longer stalls the app's other requests.

changes.zh: 发给写作模型的证据和人群筛选计数中，1 到 10 的小计数一律隐去，也无法再由总数、比例或筛选链上的其他计数反推出来。
changes.en: Counts of 1 to 10 are withheld from the evidence and the selection counts sent to the writing model, and can no longer be recovered from published totals, rates or the other counts in the selection chain.

changes.zh: 论文正文里的数字只有在句子写明了对应的变量、统计量、单位和组别时，才会绑定到同类型的结果；含糊时不再绑定到错误的结果。
changes.en: A number in the manuscript text binds to a result of the same kind only when the sentence names its variable, statistic, unit and group; ambiguous numbers are no longer bound to the wrong result.

changes.zh: 尿量 12 小时间隔判定对时间平移不敏感：恰好 12 小时保留，多 1 秒判为间断。
changes.en: The 12-hour urine gap rule no longer depends on the absolute clock: exactly 12 hours is kept, 1 second more is a gap.

changes.zh: 命令行遇到常见输入问题时给出一行可操作的英文提示并以退出码 2 结束：需要授权的数据库不再尝试下载（请从 PhysioNet 手动下载后转换），未准备好的目录提示先运行转换；easyicu-llm-server --help 不再要求先设置密钥。
changes.en: The command line answers common input problems with one actionable English line and exit code 2: credentialed databases are no longer downloaded (download them from PhysioNet, then convert), an unprepared directory asks you to run the converter first, and easyicu-llm-server --help no longer requires a key.

changes.zh: 命令行 easyicu extract 在数据库被跳过或没有导出任何行时返回非零退出码。
changes.en: The easyicu extract command exits non-zero when a requested database is skipped or yields no rows.

changes.zh: 可选导出模块 weight_strict 提供入 ICU 时可知的单次体重及其来源和时间，原有 weight 不变。
changes.en: The opt-in weight_strict export module gives one stay weight known at ICU admission, with its source and time; the existing weight is unchanged.

changes.zh: 生成计划前先请你确认系统提议的主要结局；确认卡直接保存你确认的结局。
changes.en: Before the plan is drafted, you confirm the proposed primary outcome; the card saves the outcome you confirm.

changes.zh: eICU、HiRID 无法确定同一患者跨住院的首次 ICU 入住时，会先说明并给出替代口径（每次住院的首次入住，或全部入住按患者聚类），人群卡写明口径。
changes.en: When eICU or HiRID cannot order a patient's stays across hospitalizations, a per-patient first-stay request is answered up front with alternatives (first stay per hospitalization, or all stays clustered by patient), and the population card states the scope.

changes.zh: 数据能按患者分组时，第一版计划直接按患者聚类处理重复入住，不再连跑两次计划。
changes.en: When the data groups stays by patient, the first plan already clusters repeated stays by patient, so a second plan no longer follows.

changes.zh: 点结果数字可看到对比组、参照组、样本量、单位、时间界标和调整变量。
changes.en: Tracing a result number shows its contrast, reference, sample, unit, landmark and adjustment.

changes.zh: 论文正文按变量名称书写对比（如 lactate），不再出现 lact max 这类内部列名。
changes.en: Article sentences name variables by their labels (for example lactate) instead of internal column names such as lact max.

changes.zh: 不支持一键追加的结果只显示一行说明，不再列出点不了的选项；下一步建议去重。
changes.en: Results that cannot take one-click additions show one line instead of options that cannot run; next-step choices are deduplicated.

changes.zh: 修正时间网格补齐时观测越界写入下一位患者的问题，少量 SOFA 总分随之更正。
changes.en: Gap filling no longer writes an observation past one patient's grid into the next patient; a few SOFA totals change accordingly.

changes.zh: 新增 NWICU、浙江 eICU、金华、自贡四个社区 ICU 数据源（仅映射）；修正 MIMIC-III/IV 与 AUMC 的葡萄糖、血氧、氧分压、尿量和入量取数，新增 FiO2/PEEP 来源通道。
changes.en: Adds four community ICU sources (NWICU, Zhejiang eICU, Jinhua, Zigong; mapping only); corrects dextrose, oxygen saturation, PaO2, urine and fluid-input mappings for MIMIC-III/IV and AUMC, and adds FiO2/PEEP source channels.

changes.zh: 对话侧栏按任务列出：待你处理的单独成组，最近的在前，可打开全部任务表搜索和筛选。
changes.en: The conversation rail lists tasks: those waiting for you are grouped first, recent ones follow, and a full task table can be searched and filtered.

changes.zh: 项目成果里，被当前计划取代、没跑到分析的早期尝试会收起，不再一条条标红。
changes.en: In project results, early attempts superseded by the current plan that never reached an analysis are folded instead of listed in red.

changes.zh: 研究可以使用无呼吸机天数等“存活且无事件天数”、有序结局和计数结局。
changes.en: Studies can use free-day outcomes such as ventilator-free days, ordinal outcomes and count outcomes.

changes.zh: 新增跨库外部验证、各数据库效应的 REML 合并、g-方法（MSM 与单时点 g-formula）和重复测量的混合模型与 GEE。
changes.en: Adds cross-database external validation, REML pooling of per-database effects, g-methods (MSM and point g-formula) and mixed models and GEE for repeated measures.

changes.zh: 支持多重插补并按 Rubin 规则合并；数据预处理（异常值、时间窗汇总、单位统一、缺失处理、标准化）在计划中逐项可见。
changes.en: Supports multiple imputation pooled by Rubin's rules; data preparation (outliers, window aggregation, units, missing data, scaling) is listed step by step in the plan.

changes.zh: 在输入框输入 / 可以直接选用技能。
changes.en: Typing / in the composer picks a skill directly.

changes.zh: 设置中可选择数据和项目的存放位置；桌面版用系统钥匙串记住模型密钥。
changes.en: Settings choose where data and projects are stored; the desktop app remembers model keys in the system keychain.

changes.zh: 技能中心各页统一标题与操作；技能可以打包导入导出。
changes.en: Skill Hub tabs share one header and actions; skills can be imported and exported as packages.

changes.zh: 新增 MIMIC-III 官方演示数据，可以在旧版 MIMIC 结构上从抽取一直做到出图。
changes.en: Adds the official MIMIC-III demo, so the whole path from extraction to figures also runs on the older MIMIC structure.

changes.zh: 在对话侧栏点搜索，可以查找所有项目里的对话、计划、结果和文件，点开直接到对应的位置。
changes.en: Search from the conversation rail finds conversations, plans, results and files in every project and opens the exact place.

changes.zh: 需要你确认的计划、已完成或失败的运行会在项目和对话旁标出，浏览器标签上显示待处理的数量。
changes.en: Plans waiting for you and runs that finished or failed are marked beside their project and conversation, with the count in the browser tab.

changes.zh: 科学审阅逐项列出方法、数据与材料、数字核对和局限，每一项都能查看来源；没有证据记录的数字排在最前并标出。
changes.en: Scientific review lists the approach, data and materials, number check and limitations item by item, each with its source; numbers without an evidence record come first and are marked.

changes.zh: 结果下方会给出可以直接追加的后续分析。
changes.en: Results suggest follow-up analyses you can add directly.

changes.zh: 在输入框里选研究技能，或设为项目新对话的默认技能；内置技能可以复制成自己的版本再修改。
changes.en: Pick a research skill in the composer or make it the project's default for new conversations; copy a built-in skill to edit your own version.

changes.zh: 设置里可以写给 Copilot 的长期说明；模型菜单里显示本对话和最近一次分析的用量。
changes.en: Settings take standing instructions for Copilot; the model menu shows usage for this conversation and the latest analysis.

changes.zh: 可以下载一项研究的回放，发给导师或合作者：问题、计划、结果和汇总图表，只含汇总数据；有少于 20 人的分组时不会生成。
changes.en: Download a study's replay to send to a supervisor or co-author: question, plan, results and aggregate figures only; it is not made when a group has fewer than 20 patients.

changes.zh: 每次运行和每段对话都能查看发送给模型的记录：用途、服务商、内容类型和大小，不显示发出的原文。
changes.en: Every run and conversation shows what was sent to the model: purpose, provider, kind of content and size, never the text sent.

changes.zh: 运行出问题时可以下载问题报告：只含版本、运行状态和原因代码，不含数据、提示词和对话内容，由你决定是否发给支持人员。
changes.en: When a run goes wrong you can download a problem report with versions, run state and reason codes only, no data, prompts or conversation text, and decide yourself whether to send it.

changes.zh: 数据字典新增“来源表”视图：按数据库查看每张原始表、表中读取的值/单位/时间字段，以及从中读取的全部变量；由其他变量计算的变量列出其输入变量。
changes.en: The data dictionary has a Source tables view: for each database it shows every raw table, the value, unit and time fields read from it, and all variables read from it; a variable computed from other variables lists its inputs.

changes.zh: 生存曲线及其他图表中使用主题色的第一条曲线此前不显示，现已修复。
changes.en: Fixed charts in which the first series, drawn in the theme colour, was not shown, including the first Kaplan–Meier curve.

changes.zh: 队列统计用目录中的变量名和单位代替列代码（如“乳酸 mmol/L”而不是 LACT）；跨库对比的病死率在部分结局缺失时注明已知人数；患者审阅的模块数和可用信号数与数据一致。
changes.en: Cohort statistics names variables by their catalog names and units instead of column codes (Lactate mmol/L, not LACT); a cross-database mortality rate states its known denominator when outcomes are partly missing; Patient review module and signal counts match the data.

changes.zh: 仓库历史已重写，移除了不应公开的文件；此前的 0.1.x 预发布版本已撤回，由本版本取代。
changes.en: The repository history was rewritten to remove files that should not have been published; earlier 0.1.x pre-releases were withdrawn and this release replaces them.
